title: Aoyagi Toya — Fear That I've Felt〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Local Musicians
rows.Line: Man, how awesome was the battle An and Kohane had the other day?!

rows.Speaker: Local Musicians
rows.Line: I know, right?! I still have no idea why it happened, but they both sounded super serious...

rows.Speaker: Local Musicians
rows.Line: That was the most mind-blowing battle I'd ever seen!

rows.Speaker: Local Musicians
rows.Line: Same here. I can't wait for their next event...!
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The entire city's been talking about us following their battle...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'm sensing this mix of excitement and tension in the air.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The fire we lit that day has clearly grown much bigger...!)
Weekend Garage
se_walk_men_004_1

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh. Morning, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Good morning.
I didn't realize you were already here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Nod*
But you're also here pretty early.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, so... I woke up and didn't have anything else to do at home.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. I know the feeling! It feels better to practice here than laze around at home, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me...!
There's something I need to say to you!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To me?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks for the advice you gave me about how I felt about Kohane.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You helped me realize that I had all this fear swirling around inside of me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was able to take another hard look at myself and tell Kohane how I really felt.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
There's no need to thank me.
I was just doing what I should as your teammate.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm just glad that I could help you two somehow.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
By the way, how are you doing now?
Do you feel less anxious after battling against Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hmm... Yeah, kinda...
It's more or less gone for now...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: For now?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I feel pretty good right now...
But I'm pretty sure it's gonna be back again eventually.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: At the same time, I think that's fine.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No matter what happens...
No matter how hard things get...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We'll keep pushing and pulling. We'll keep chasing after each other. I finally know that this is what I've always wanted out of a partner.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But if I do get stuck again in the future, I won't just let my feelings fester. I'll be sure to let it all out...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I'd expect no less from you, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. I don't plan on losing to you or Akito either, so you guys better stay ready.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's good to hear.
I'll make sure to be ready for when that happens.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness...
I'm so glad that Shiraishi's been able to find a way to move forward.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Come to think of it...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Does this mean I've finally been able to repay them for what they did for me back then?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But that's not the case when you're up there with Akito. I can always tell you're having fun.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What is it that you really want, Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Because they went out of their way that time to ask me how I really felt...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I feel like I was finally able to become the partner that Akito deserves.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Despite how poorly we treated them back then... They were still willing to show concern for us.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I can't thank them enough for that.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I was finally able to give back a little.
But more importantly...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I still have a long way to go, but it makes me really happy to be able to work so hard toward something with her.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I remember being stunned by the deep trust they placed in one another, as well as their determination to keep moving forward...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Which is why I'm glad I've been able to help them become even better partners.)
se_walk_women_004_1
se_walk_men_004_2

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, you guys are here pretty early.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe. We couldn't wait to start practicing!
Right, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, let's get started.
